text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek is looking over at me with a sleepy expression…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mmm… Oh, Trainer, you're such a sweet little cutie-pie…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I'm sorry. It seems I had my head in the clouds for a bit there…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I need to get myself together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You work so hard to pick all these races for me… I need to try harder… to win them…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek mumbles before slipping back into her drowsy reverie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Have I put too much on her plate? I might need to rethink her race schedule.
